<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en-IN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />

  <title>Creative Dreamz | Premium Photography, Wedding Films, Live Streaming & Printing Services</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Creative Dreamz provides premium photography, cinematic wedding films, live streaming, wedding invitations, pre-wedding shoots, aerial shoots, post-production, large photo prints, photo frames, sublimation printing and personalized gift services across Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana." />
  <meta name="keywords" content="Creative Dreamz, photography services Vijayawada, wedding photography Visakhapatnam, wedding photography Hyderabad, wedding films Andhra Pradesh, event photography Telangana, live streaming services, wedding invitation design, pre wedding shoot, aerial shoot, drone shoot, post production services, large photo printing, photo frames, sublimation printing, personalized gifts, wedding return gifts" />
  <meta name="author" content="Creative Dreamz" />
  <meta name="robots" content="index, follow, max-image-preview:large" />
  <link rel="canonical" href="https://creativedreamz.in/" />

  <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
  <meta property="og:title" content="Creative Dreamz | Photography, Films, Live Streaming, Prints & Gifts" />
  <meta property="og:description" content="Premium photography, cinematic wedding films, live streaming, invitations, drone shoots, post-production, large prints, frames and personalized gifts across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana." />
  <meta property="og:url" content="https://creativedreamz.in/" />
  <meta property="og:site_name" content="Creative Dreamz" />
  <meta property="og:image" content="https://creativedreamz.in/assets/wedding-stage.png" />

  <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
  <meta name="twitter:title" content="Creative Dreamz | Premium Event Photography & Creative Production" />
  <meta name="twitter:description" content="Photography, wedding films, live streaming, post-production, invitations, drone shoots, photo printing, frames and personalized gifts across AP & Telangana." />
  <meta name="twitter:image" content="https://creativedreamz.in/assets/wedding-stage.png" />

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Great+Vibes&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />

  <script type="application/ld+json">
  {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "LocalBusiness",
    "name": "Creative Dreamz",
    "url": "https://creativedreamz.in/",
    "image": "https://creativedreamz.in/assets/wedding-stage.png",
    "description": "Premium photography, cinematic wedding films, live streaming, post-production, wedding invitations, pre-wedding shoots, aerial shoots, large photo prints, photo frames, sublimation printing and personalized gift services.",
    "email": "creativedreamz1@gmail.com",
    "telephone": "+91 94933 95333",
    "areaServed": [
      "Vijayawada",
      "Visakhapatnam",
      "Hyderabad",
      "Andhra Pradesh",
      "Telangana"
    ],
    "makesOffer": [
      { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Wedding Photography" } },
      { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Cinematic Wedding Films" } },
      { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Live Streaming" } },
      { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Wedding Invitation Design" } },
      { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Large Photo Prints and Frames" } },
      { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Sublimation Printing and Personalized Gifts" } }
    ]
  }
  </script>

  <style>
    :root {
      --ivory: #fffaf2;
      --cream: #fff4df;
      --paper: #ffffff;
      --peach: #ffe8d5;
      --blush: #ffe1df;
      --gold: #b7791f;
      --gold-2: #d7a24b;
      --deep: #2d1710;
      --brown: #6f4a25;
      --muted: #786d63;
      --soft: #f6eee4;
      --line: rgba(122, 86, 42, .16);
      --shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(83, 52, 19, .12);
      --shadow-strong: 0 28px 70px rgba(83, 52, 19, .18);
      --radius: 26px;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      color: var(--deep);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 12% 10%, rgba(255, 222, 203, .68), transparent 30%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 88% 18%, rgba(255, 237, 194, .78), transparent 32%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fffaf2 0%, #ffffff 38%, #fff8ed 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    body::before {
      content: "";
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: .28;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(183, 121, 31, .04) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(rgba(183, 121, 31, .035) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 42px 42px;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    img {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
    }

    .container {
      width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 34px));
      margin-inline: auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .skip-link {
      position: absolute;
      left: -999px;
      top: 0;
      background: var(--deep);
      color: white;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      z-index: 1000;
    }

    .skip-link:focus {
      left: 10px;
      top: 10px;
    }

    .topbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 80;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.86);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(83, 52, 19, .06);
    }

    .nav {
      height: 78px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 22px;
    }

    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      min-width: max-content;
    }

    .brand-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, #fff6e6, #f0c974),
        radial-gradient(circle at 25% 20%, #fff, transparent 32%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(183, 121, 31, .22);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      color: var(--gold);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(183, 121, 31, .18);
    }

    .brand-name {
      font-family: "Great Vibes", cursive;
      font-size: clamp(1.95rem, 3vw, 2.7rem);
      color: var(--gold);
      line-height: .85;
      white-space: nowrap;
      text-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(183, 121, 31, .15);
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 24px;
      font-size: .92rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #4b3c31;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      position: relative;
      padding: 10px 0;
    }

    .nav-links a::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      right: 100%;
      bottom: 3px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--gold);
      transition: right .25s ease;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover::after {
      right: 0;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      min-height: 46px;
      padding: 13px 19px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(183, 121, 31, .28);
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c58928, #aa690d);
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .01em;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(183, 121, 31, .24);
      transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, background .2s ease;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 34px rgba(183, 121, 31, .29);
    }

    .btn.light {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.84);
      color: var(--gold);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(83, 52, 19, .08);
    }

    .btn.small {
      min-height: 40px;
      padding: 10px 15px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: .88rem;
    }

    .mobile-toggle {
      display: none;
      border: 0;
      width: 46px;
      height: 46px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--soft);
      color: var(--deep);
      font-size: 1.3rem;
    }

    .hero {
      min-height: 710px;
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      align-items: stretch;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      background: var(--ivory);
    }

    .hero-media {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero-media img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: 70% center;
      filter: saturate(1.06) contrast(1.03);
    }

    .hero-media::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,250,242,.98) 0%, rgba(255,250,242,.94) 30%, rgba(255,250,242,.62) 48%, rgba(255,250,242,.06) 74%),
        linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255,250,242,.88) 0%, transparent 22%, transparent 78%, rgba(255,250,242,.42) 100%);
    }

    .hero .container {
      display: grid;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 710px;
      padding: 84px 0 76px;
    }

    .hero-content {
      max-width: 620px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 11px;
      color: var(--gold);
      font-size: .78rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .eyebrow::before {
      content: "";
      width: 48px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--gold-2);
    }

    h1, h2 {
      font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
      color: var(--deep);
      letter-spacing: -.04em;
    }

    h1 {
      font-size: clamp(3.1rem, 6vw, 6.1rem);
      line-height: .96;
      max-width: 740px;
    }

    .gold {
      color: var(--gold);
    }

    .hero-lead {
      margin-top: 18px;
      color: #3b2b23;
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.32rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.45;
      max-width: 560px;
    }

    .hero-text {
      margin-top: 17px;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.82;
      max-width: 560px;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .hero-trust {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 34px;
      max-width: 610px;
    }

    .trust-card {
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(83,52,19,.08);
    }

    .trust-card b {
      display: block;
      color: var(--gold);
      font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .trust-card span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 7px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: .85rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    section {
      padding: 84px 0;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .section-head {
      max-width: 820px;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
    }

    .section-head.center {
      text-align: center;
      margin-inline: auto;
    }

    .kicker {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      color: var(--gold);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: .82rem;
      letter-spacing: .13em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .center .kicker {
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .kicker::before,
    .kicker::after {
      content: "";
      width: 32px;
      height: 1px;
      background: rgba(183, 121, 31, .42);
    }

    .kicker::after {
      display: none;
    }

    .center .kicker::after {
      display: block;
    }

    h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 4rem);
      line-height: 1.05;
    }

    .section-copy {
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-top: 14px;
      line-height: 1.82;
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .services-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .service-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.88);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 22px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      transition: transform .28s ease, box-shadow .28s ease, border-color .28s ease;
    }

    .service-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-strong);
      border-color: rgba(183, 121, 31, .34);
    }

    .service-img {
      height: 168px;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .service-img img {
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform .55s ease;
    }

    .service-card:hover .service-img img {
      transform: scale(1.07);
    }

    .service-icon {
      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      margin: -29px auto 11px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #fff;
      color: var(--gold);
      border: 1px solid rgba(183,121,31,.24);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 25px rgba(83,52,19,.10);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
    }

    .service-content {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 18px 24px;
    }

    .service-content h3 {
      font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      line-height: 1.24;
      margin-bottom: 9px;
    }

    .service-content p {
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.56;
      font-size: .93rem;
    }

    .portfolio {
      padding-top: 34px;
    }

    .gallery-strip {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .9fr .9fr 1.2fr;
      grid-auto-rows: 190px;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .gallery-item {
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
      position: relative;
      background: var(--soft);
    }

    .gallery-item.large {
      grid-row: span 2;
    }

    .gallery-item img {
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform .55s ease;
    }

    .gallery-item:hover img {
      transform: scale(1.06);
    }

    .gallery-item::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 55%, rgba(45,23,16,.32));
      opacity: .7;
    }

    .feature-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 26px;
      margin-top: 42px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      min-height: 390px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: .86fr 1.14fr;
      gap: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .feature-card.reverse {
      grid-template-columns: 1.04fr .96fr;
    }

    .feature-text {
      padding: 34px;
      align-self: center;
    }

    .feature-text h3 {
      font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.65rem, 3vw, 2.45rem);
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 15px;
    }

    .list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 11px;
      margin: 20px 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .list li {
      color: #5f534b;
      font-weight: 800;
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: .95rem;
    }

    .list li::before {
      content: "✦";
      color: var(--gold);
      font-size: .92rem;
    }

    .feature-text p {
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.72;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .feature-image {
      min-height: 390px;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .feature-image img {
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .gifts-card .feature-image {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff3e7, #fff);
      padding: 25px;
      display: grid;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .gifts-card .feature-image img {
      object-fit: contain;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 26px rgba(83,52,19,.14));
    }

    .stream-banner {
      margin-top: 28px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: .95fr 1.05fr;
      min-height: 390px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 28px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(183,121,31,.18);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 12% 18%, rgba(255,226,190,.85), transparent 34%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #fffaf2, #fff);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .stream-text {
      padding: 42px;
      align-self: center;
    }

    .stream-text h3 {
      font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      line-height: 1.08;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .stream-text p {
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.78;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .stream-features {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 26px;
    }

    .stream-features span {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: .9rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #58463a;
    }

    .stream-features span::before {
      content: "◎";
      color: var(--gold);
    }

    .stream-image {
      min-height: 390px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .stream-image img {
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center;
    }

    .locations {
      padding-top: 70px;
      padding-bottom: 46px;
    }

    .location-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .location-card {
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 17px;
      padding: 19px 15px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(83,52,19,.08);
      color: #4d4037;
      font-weight: 900;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .location-card span:first-child {
      color: var(--gold);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
    }

    .seo-section {
      padding-top: 46px;
    }

    .seo-panel {
      border-radius: 28px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(183,121,31,.18);
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.92), rgba(255,247,235,.92)),
        radial-gradient(circle at right top, rgba(255,210,175,.6), transparent 32%);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      padding: 34px;
    }

    .keyword-cloud {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 20px;
    }

    .keyword-cloud a {
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      color: #5f4533;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: .87rem;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(83,52,19,.06);
      transition: all .22s ease;
    }

    .keyword-cloud a:hover {
      background: var(--gold);
      color: #fff;
      border-color: transparent;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .contact {
      padding-top: 54px;
      padding-bottom: 0;
    }

    .contact-box {
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 32px 32px 0 0;
      border: 1px solid rgba(183,121,31,.16);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 4% 100%, rgba(255, 218, 220, .95), transparent 31%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 92% 15%, rgba(255, 230, 186, .9), transparent 30%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #fff7ef, #ffffff);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-strong);
      padding: 45px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1px .9fr .8fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
    }

    .contact-box::before {
      content: "✿";
      position: absolute;
      left: 14px;
      bottom: -8px;
      color: rgba(183,121,31,.14);
      font-size: 7rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .contact-box h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 4vw, 3.35rem);
    }

    .script {
      font-family: "Great Vibes", cursive;
      color: var(--gold);
      font-size: 2.1rem;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    .divider {
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 170px;
      width: 1px;
      background: rgba(183,121,31,.22);
    }

    .contact-lines {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .contact-line {
      display: flex;
      gap: 13px;
      align-items: center;
      color: #4d4037;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .contact-line i {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(183,121,31,.10);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      color: var(--gold);
      font-style: normal;
    }

    .socials {
      display: flex;
      gap: 11px;
      margin-top: 15px;
    }

    .socials a {
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(183,121,31,.2);
      color: var(--gold);
      font-weight: 900;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 18px rgba(83,52,19,.08);
    }

    .footer {
      background: #fff;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      padding: 24px 0;

    document.getElementById("year").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    const revealElements = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add("visible");
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12 });

    revealElements.forEach((el, index) => {
      el.style.transitionDelay = `${Math.min(index * 45, 240)}ms`;
      observer.observe(el);
    });

    const mobileToggle = document.querySelector(".mobile-toggle");
    const navLinks = document.querySelector(".nav-links");
